messages.body_plain:
I have Searched the net but couldn't find How to do the same thing for the geom_bars.

Can I do the same for geom_bar? If Yes then what would be the approach. I have Y values which are selected based on my selection of  a different variable. As for example I have this dataframe

                   df <- data.frame(Scenarios = c(rep("Land",3),"Land_1"), Year = c(rep("2050",2), "2030"), Area_Crop =
                                            c(100,200,300,400), Area_Water = c(40,50,60,70), Area_Forest =  c(150,250,350,450))

The selection from this table has to be used to plot a bar on an already existing bar plot where the Y values are already plotted for each year. This values can be melted using Scenarios and Year as measure.vars to bring it under one column (our Y value) and the same has been done on the table for the already existing plot.

In  short I select a scenario than its respective bar plot should be added to the existing barplot just like you did it for the points.

On Thursday, August 7, 2014 at 9:00:39 PM UTC+5:30, Sigbert Klinke wrote:
> Hi,
>
> for similar problem I used a global variable in server.R, e.g. like
>
> points <- list(x=vector("numeric", 0), y=vector("numeric", 0))
>
> shinyServer(function(input, output) {
>
>   output$plotPoints <-  <- renderPlot({
>      ok <- input$add
>      points$x <<- c(points$x, isolate(input$x))
>      points$y <<- c(points$y, isolate(input$y))
>      plot(points$x, points$y)
>   })
>
> })
>
>
> "add" is the button to click on and "x" and "y" are the input fields for the new additional coordinates. Best Sigbert
>

messages.body_plain:
Dear All,

Greetings to everyone

I am building an app where I need to add input panels and make entries. The entries should manifest itself into a reactive table. The added panels can also be deleted along with its entries. As such the reactive table should get expanded or retracted based on the addition and deletion of panels.

All this is ultimately saved into a R form.

My reactive table is only taking the values from one set of panels (the recent ones) and thus making an one row table. Also the update input is not working which is causing the app to crash( so commented out in the code).

How to handle the input ids of InsertUI to generate a reactive table and update inputs?
Is there any direct JS functions available for doing the similar things by using the input IDs?

I am giving you the simple code with selection from three panels (added as a set of panels upon clicking Add). The Update button saves the entries into a R form.

I have attached the R script file to access the code

The errors produced in the code are as follows

Not able to think as to why this error, because the Scenario_Key is already a variable in the   Landuse_Values$DF.

    Warning: Error in data.frame: arguments imply differing number of rows: 1, 0
         [No stack trace available]

   Warning: Error in updateNumericInput: formal argument "min" matched by
   multiple actual arguments
